Barbell Back Squat.note: Trains the quads and glutes, which push you back up out of the bottom.

Barbell Bent-Over Row.note: Back work: lats, rhomboids, mid-traps and rear delts pull, biceps help.

Conventional Barbell Deadlift.note: Trains glutes, hamstrings and lower back, with the quads driving off the floor.

Dumbbell Bicep Curl (standing, both arms.note: Trains the biceps, with the forearms helping flex the elbow.

Dumbbell Lateral Raise.note: Trains the side of the shoulder, with the front delt helping lift.

Dumbbell Shoulder Press (seated overhead.note: Overhead press for the front and side delts, with triceps and traps helping.

Flat Barbell Bench Press.note: Chest press: the chest does the pushing, front delts and triceps help.

Front Plank (forearm plank).note: Trains the abs and obliques to hold your body in one straight line.

Lat Pulldown (seated, to the front).note: Lats do the pulling, with rhomboids, mid-traps, rear delts and biceps helping.

Leg Press (seated machine).note: Works the glutes, quads and hamstrings, with inner thighs and calves helping.

Pull-Up.note: Lats and rhomboids pull you up; biceps, mid-traps and rear delts help.

Standing Barbell Overhead Press (Shoulde.note: Shoulder press: front and side delts drive it, triceps and traps help.

Tricep Pushdown (cable, bar or rope atta.note: Trains the triceps on the back of the upper arm; only the elbows move.

Walking Lunge (dumbbells optional).note: Front-leg glutes and quads do the work, with hamstrings and inner thigh helping.
